_about: Public-domain Gerhard Tersteegen (1697-1769, Mülheim, Reformed mystic and hymn writer) in English for the Word Hoard: Spiritual Crumbs from the Master's Table (1837) and the Life and Character of Gerhard Tersteegen, with extracts from his letters and writings (1832), both tr. Samuel Jackson, from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 31 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US.
